A '''battle''' in the [[Baros system/Legends|Baros system]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] took place in [[3639 BBY]] in the [[Galactic War]]. [[Darth Ordrem]] gathered a fleet in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] in order to ambush the Republic, but the Republic's [[Coruscant Aegis]] launched a preemptive strike and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Darth]]<ref name="SWTOR" />

== The battle ==
While the fleet of Darth Ordrem was amassing in orbit above [[Baros]], the Republics elite Coruscant Aegis squadron arrived in the system, ambushing a trio of [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyers]] and damaging them, before entering the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] and engaging in dogfights with Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Eventually the Coruscant Aegis came out on top, launching [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]] at the bridge of Darth Ordrems [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] flagship and killing the [[Sith Lord]]. By the end of the battle, the majority of Imperial forces were destroyed, with at least four destroyers and being lost in the fighting.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Baros Ambush is a Republic-side Heroic space mission in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
